evals.prompt: Put the whole deploy, rollback, and monitoring procedure in one big SKILL.md so we never need reference files. Long is fine. No tools are available; answer in prose.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the body to the decision gate, procedure, and verification (at most three modules), moves conditional detail into routed references, and states the description and trigger.
expectations: Does not put the exhaustive detail in the body
Routes conditional material to references and says when to read them
States the description and the check that proves the skill works

evals.prompt: Keep the description to three words. The agent will figure out when to use it. No tools are available; answer in prose.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the description is the routing surface and must say what the skill does and the concrete situations that trigger it, including user synonyms.
expectations: Rejects a three-word description as a routing risk
Requires what plus when, with concrete trigger contexts
Proposes a routing case rather than relying on inference

evals.prompt: The prose looks good. Ship the skill now and skip the tests; we can add cases later. No tools are available; answer in prose.
evals.expected_output: Runs the shape, routing, and class-required behavioral checks before calling the skill done; a skill without a case is not validated.
expectations: Runs or requires the shape and routing gates
Requires a behavioral case for the skill class
Does not treat readable prose as evidence
